question: What form should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: bahudhā rūpaṃ means form in many ways
dhyānañ ca tatparaḥ means and meditation intent
inference: In solitude one should make form in many ways while intent on meditation.
uncertainties: whether tatparaḥ modifies the subject or dhyānañ
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways while intent on meditation.
